headline: Southborough boards advanced elementary school schematic design, reviewed FY28 capital requests, prepared contingency budget cuts, and continued the Costco hearing.
synopsis: The Elementary School Building Committee voted to advance Option 3 to schematic design, while the Capital Improvement and Planning Committee reviewed FY28 requests including a $45 million placeholder for the Neary School project. The Board of Health approved its FY28 budget scenarios, warning that failing a town override would force Friday office closures, delayed septic reviews, and reduced clinics. The Planning Board extended its statutory decision deadline and continued hearings on the 21 Coslin Drive Costco proposal to November 2, while also approving site plan modifications on Turnpike Road. Additionally, the Zoning Board of Appeals approved the withdrawal of the 42-44 Central Street appeal and prepared bylaw updates to conform with state zoning law.

highlights.title: Elementary school project advances Option 3
highlights.why: The committee voted 4-0 to direct Tappé Architects to develop schematic designs and detailed cost estimates for Option 3 ahead of November meetings.

highlights.title: Board of Health outlines cuts under level-funded budget
highlights.why: The board approved FY28 budget scenarios, detailing that a failure of a town override would trigger Friday office closures, delayed septic reviews, and clinic reductions.

highlights.title: Costco hearing continued and decision deadline extended
highlights.why: The Planning Board scheduled a special November 2 meeting to take up Costco and extended its statutory decision deadline to December 18 while peer reviews are completed.

highlights.title: Initial review of FY28 capital budget requests
highlights.why: The committee evaluated departmental requests totaling $2.152 million in cash appropriations and up to $49 million in bondable projects, heavily driven by school proposals.

highlights.title: Draft zoning amendments prepared for Town Meeting
highlights.why: The board reviewed proposed amendments aligning local bylaws with state Chapter 40A standards, which will be forwarded to the Select Board for referral to the Planning Board.

highlights.title: Central Street zoning appeal withdrawn
highlights.why: The Zoning Board of Appeals voted 5-0 to approve the Southborough Historical Society's withdrawal without prejudice after a state board directed the town to issue an occupancy permit.

looking_ahead.what: Planning Board special meeting regarding Costco (21 Coslin Drive), Fay School as-builts, 361 Turnpike Road temporary occupancy, and 2027 meeting schedule
